<div class='flex_column av-ve82-52a35102bcf5d36e8a56e6ca17a31eb0 av_one_half  avia-builder-el-9  el_after_av_one_half  el_before_av_hr  flex_column_div '     ><section  class='av_textblock_section av-leeblx3b-80658a17afaf1898d34e4cfcc64feae5'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p class="font_8">Singapore Tenants United for Fairness(SGTUFF) came to life in February 2020 primarily because the Coronavirus pandemic forced business owners from the Retail, Food and Beverage and Services sectors to come together to discuss how to collectively address the issues faced by tenants in commercial properties. There are now 700+ verified frontline business owners in our group representing 600+ brands in 2,600+ retail outlets, occupying 3.5mil+ sq ft of commercial space with a 20,000+ strong workforce.</p>
<p class="font_8"><span class="wixGuard">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8">Our Group has been very active in representing the community on engaging with multiple government ministries like Ministry of Trade and Industry, Ministry of Law, working with fellow Trade Associations like Association of Small and Medium Enterprises, Restaurant Association Singapore & Singapore Retailers Association and engaging landlords to give feedback and recommendations on what are the short term and long term measures that will address the core issues faced by frontline businesses. We are also part of the Fair Tenancy Framework Industry Committee. SGTUFF has also started multiple community building and self-help initiatives to form new alliances, new ideas and promote synergies amongst frontline businesses.</p>
</div></section></div>

<div  class='hr av-lef47zir-45974a80ddd28e5f3c066db663bb9825 hr-invisible  avia-builder-el-14  el_after_av_heading  el_before_av_textblock '><span class='hr-inner '><span class="hr-inner-style"></span></span></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-lef40vni-536da706068e45911f906cec05890d6f'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock av_inherit_color'  itemprop="text" ><p style="text-align: center;">The vision for SGTUFF Co-Operative is to be an advocate for frontline businesses on Fair Tenancy and LL-Tenant matters</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">as well as to leverage collective community scale and synergies to provide both business cost savings to members and stakeholders.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">We hope to build our community to include all frontlines businesses in Singapore and to stand as an indomitable force for Fair Tenancy,</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">symbiotic relationship with Landlords and as an agent of change to revive and rejuvenate Singapore’s image</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">as a premier shop & dine destination for tourists and travellers.</p>

<li>
<p class="font_8">SGTUFF represents and advocates for frontline businesses (focus on SME and micro and nano-SME) on key common areas of interest especially Fair Tenancy and Manpower matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="font_8">SGTUFF provides meaningful and relevant activities/services to our community in areas like cost savings on shared services, digitization, legal help, business advisory, business synergy/networking and lease/rental information.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="font_8">SGTUFF reinvents frontline business models in Singapore in the pursuit of successful pivoting or driving further growth in so doing, help to regain Singapore’s status as the premier Shopping, Wine & Dine and Services destination in the world.</p>
</li>
</ol>

<section  class='av_textblock_section av-legsbi2m-5d0a807b08bca1ed8034fd959fd6b218'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p class="font_8" style="text-align: center;">The Fair Tenancy Pro Tem Committee was formed with key representatives from Singapore’s landlord and tenant communities on 26 June 2020, so as to strengthen collaboration and increase the vibrancy and competitiveness of Singapore’s retail, food & beverages (F&B) and lifestyle sectors.</p>
<p class="font_8" style="text-align: center;">The result is an industry-led <a title="Code of Conduct for Leasing of Retail Premises in Singapore" href="https://sgtuff.org.sg/219-2/master-the-code-of-conduct-for-retail-leasing-enhance-your-business-with-fair-tenancy-practices/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Code of Conduct for Leasing of Retail Premises in Singapore</strong></a> (“Code”) based on the principles of transparency, reciprocity and sustainability.</p>
<p class="font_8" style="text-align: center;">The Fair Tenancy Industry Committee (FTIC) was set up on 3 May 2021, to be the custodian of the Code and ensure that it provides guidance to landlords and tenants of qualifying retail premises so that fair and balanced lease negotiations can be achieved. It is represented by both landlords and tenants, as well neutral parties to offer a holistic approach when addressing matters related to retail lease agreements.</p>
<p class="font_8" style="text-align: center;">If you have any enquires, please direct them to <a href="mailto:info@sgtuff.org.sg" data-auto-recognition="true">info@sgtuff.org.sg</a></p>
</div></section></div>

                    <article class="post-entry post-entry-type-standard post-entry-501430 post-loop-1 post-parity-odd post-entry-last multi-big  post-501430 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-uncategorized"  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting" itemprop="blogPost" ><div class="blog-meta"><a href='https://sgtuff.org.sg/author/kerine/' class='post-author-format-type'><span class='rounded-container'><img alt='Kerine' src='https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/171661e39e7ae84cb72b6776a895b975ed8bd1de89f80d03b38ee50486190f73?s=81&d=blank&r=g' srcset='https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/171661e39e7ae84cb72b6776a895b975ed8bd1de89f80d03b38ee50486190f73?s=162&d=blank&r=g 2x' class='avatar avatar-81 photo' height='81' width='81' loading='lazy' decoding='async'/><span class="iconfont" aria-hidden='true' data-av_icon='' data-av_iconfont='entypo-fontello'></span></span></a></div><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix standard-content'><header class="entry-content-header"><h1 class='post-title entry-title '  itemprop="headline" >Home Safety & Eldercare Support – Free Benefits!<span class="post-format-icon minor-meta"></span></h1><span class="post-meta-infos"><time class="date-container minor-meta updated"  itemprop="datePublished" datetime="2026-02-23T05:58:23+00:00" >February 23, 2026</time><span class="text-sep">/</span><span class="comment-container minor-meta"><a href="https://sgtuff.org.sg/home-safety-eldercare-support-free-benefits-2/#respond" class="comments-link" >0 Comments</a></span></span></header><div class="entry-content"  itemprop="text" >
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">SGTUFF is offering Home Safety & Eldercare Support for eligible participants.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="?" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t95/2/16/1f3e0.png"> Home Safety & Elderproofing</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Edge guards, non-slip pads, motion sensor lights, bedrails & more.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="?" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t88/2/16/1f496.png"> Health & Care Support</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Homecare assessment, blood pressure monitor & optional caregiver training (Tier 2 only).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="?" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/te8/2/16/1f4da.png"> Educational Materials</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Guides on eldercare, mental health, dengue prevention, LPA & community resources.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Eligibility:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="✅" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tb4/2/16/2705.png"> Singapore Citizen / PR (residing in Singapore)</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="✅" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tb4/2/16/2705.png"> Elderly residing in HDB 3-room flat or below</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="✅" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tb4/2/16/2705.png"> Caregivers to elderly family members regardless of co-residence</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Tiered Support:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">• Tier 1: Basic home safety & education</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">• Tier 2: Enhanced elderproofing & training</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">(Assigned based on household needs)</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="?" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t6b/2/16/1f4dd.png"> Apply here: <a href="https://forms.gle/dwxpUxXvuYGJ4zjE9?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAYnJpZBEyRTlHNzgzY0t2Y3pLSTZwTnNydGMGYXBwX2lkEDIyMjAzOTE3ODgyMDA4OTIAAR4S3XoX5VptG9mTvHqSNTnUjduxEF4u73JC-2n-BTvQEQ0ik1h0m6hobEG_-g_aem_6K0ZitmsOKeBbb9zkatxHw" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">https://forms.gle/dwxpUxXvuYGJ4zjE9</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" height="16" width="16" alt="⏳" src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t38/2/16/23f3.png"> Limited spaces – first come, first served!</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="728" height="1030" src="https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-728x1030.png" alt="" class="wp-image-501431" srcset="https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-728x1030.png 728w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-212x300.png 212w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-768x1086.png 768w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-1086x1536.png 1086w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-1448x2048.png 1448w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-1060x1500.png 1060w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1-498x705.png 498w, https://sgtuff.org.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Blue-White-Modern-Minimalist-Geometric-Eldercare-Service-Appointment-Ad-Poster-1.png 1587w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 728px) 100vw, 728px" /></figure>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">SGTUFF is offering Home Safety & Eldercare Support for eligible company staff in retail, F&B & service industries.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">•Home Safety & Elderproofing<br>•Edge guards, non-slip pads, motion sensor lights, bedrails & more.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">•Health & Care Support<br>•Homecare assessment, blood pressure monitor & optional caregiver training (Tier 2 only).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">•Educational Materials<br>•Guides on eldercare, mental health, dengue prevention, LPA & community resources.<br></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Eligibility:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">•Singapore Citizen / PR(residing in Singapore)</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"> •Company staff earning below $3,000/month</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"> •Caregiver for elderly at same address</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><br>Tiered Support:<br>• Tier 1: Basic home safety & education<br>• Tier 2: Enhanced elderproofing & training<br>(Assigned based on household needs)</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"> Apply here: <a href="https://forms.gle/dwxpUxXvuYGJ4zjE9?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAYnJpZBExTG40WjVXUkJPN2dLZVJEdnNydGMGYXBwX2lkEDIyMjAzOTE3ODgyMDA4OTIAAR5YgCzOXybWEqG6VgJfbgfEtc5p7kgchkUnk_Y0NfY2OFDH_xsk1UeV0uZv0w_aem_2Y_IvZdYesEA9-o9SiCImQ" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">https://forms.gle/dwxpUxXvuYGJ4zjE9</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Closing Date: 12 Jan 2026<br>Limited spaces – first come, first served!</p>
